title: Hausdorff measure of graph points off the support via (10') and 5r-covering (Simon 5.2.6 (11))
statement:
Let n, k ∈ ℕ, μ a measure on ℝ^{n+k}, e : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ (e⁺ := ENNReal.ofReal ∘ e), sets F, A, B ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} with B measurable and A ⊆ F, K ∈ [0, ∞] and C₉, R₀ ∈ ℝ. Assume:
(a) Hⁿ(F ∩ B_r(η)) ≤ K·rⁿ for all η ∈ A and r > 0, where Hⁿ = μHE[n];
(b) for every η ∈ A there is s with 0 < s ≤ R₀, B_{3s}(η) ⊆ B and sⁿ ≤ C₉·[μ(B_{3s}(η) ∖ F) + ∫_{B_{3s}(η)} e⁺ dμ], as extended reals ofReal(sⁿ) ≤ ofReal(C₉)·[…].
Then Hⁿ(A) ≤ K·ofReal(15ⁿC₉)·[μ(B ∖ F) + ∫_B e⁺ dμ]. Balls are closed.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid (n + k))) (e : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ) (F A B : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (K : ℝ≥0∞) (C₉ R₀ : ℝ), MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ F → (∀ η ∈ A, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → μHE[n] (F ∩ closedBall η r) ≤ K * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n)) → (∀ η ∈ A, ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s ≤ R₀ ∧ closedBall η (3 * s) ⊆ B ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C₉ * (μ (closedBall η (3 * s) \ F) + ∫⁻ x in closedBall η (3 * s), ENNReal.ofReal (e x) ∂μ)) → μHE[n] A ≤ K * ENNReal.ofReal (15 ^ n * C₉) * (μ (B \ F) + ∫⁻ x in B, ENNReal.ofReal (e x) ∂μ)
